query: SELECT policy_id,pedigree,related_entities,source FROM demo_gkxlumenx_dwd.policy_base_info WHERE is_deleted=0 AND policy_id IN ('18318861','18318862','18363390','18363391','18407696','18407697')
FETCH PROP ON policy "pol:18318861","pol:18318862","pol:18363390","pol:18363391","pol:18407696","pol:18407697" YIELD id(vertex) AS vid
MATCH (p:policy)-[e:apply_to]->(t) RETURN tags(t) AS endpoint_tags,count(e) AS cnt
MATCH (p:policy)-[e:support]->(t) RETURN tags(t) AS endpoint_tags,count(e) AS cnt
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt,SUM(source='demo-mock') AS explicit_demo_mock,SUM(source IS NULL OR TRIM(source)='') AS source_empty FROM demo_gkxlumenx_dwd.policy_base_info WHERE is_deleted=0
